Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organisational skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. Understanding of Ivorian consumer behaviour, demographics, and FMCG market realities. Fluency in French and English, written and spoken. Comfort working with digital platforms, online questionnaires, tablets, and data-capture systems. Familiarity with sensory testing methodologies, including hedonic scaling, preference testing, triangle tests, and preference mapping. Experience with consumer engagement or panel loyalty programmes. Experience using sensory testing, consumer research, or panel management platforms. Experience supporting customer workshops, commercial presentations, or consumer events.
